n = int(input())
k = int(input())
p = int(input())

MAXN = (1 << 19) | 5

def power_mod(base, exp):
    res = 1
    cur = base
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = res * cur % p
        cur = cur * cur % p
        exp >>= 1
    return res

def get_lower_bound(x):
    res = 1
    while res < x:
        res <<= 1
    return res

max_power = get_lower_bound(n + 1) - 1

fact = [1] * (max_power + 1)
inv_fact = [1] * (max_power + 1)

for i in range(1, max_power + 1):
    fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % p

inv_fact[max_power] = power_mod(fact[max_power], p - 2)
for i in range(max_power - 1, -1, -1):
    inv_fact[i] = inv_fact[i + 1] * (i + 1) % p

count = [0] * (max_power + 1)
for i in range(max_power + 1):
    count[i] = bin(i).count('1')

# Initialize temporary arrays
tmp1 = [[0] * (max_power + 1) for _ in range(20)]
tmp2 = [[0] * (max_power + 1) for _ in range(20)]
tmp3 = [[0] * (max_power + 1) for _ in range(20)]
t = [[0] * (max_power + 1) for _ in range(20)]
f = [0] * (max_power + 1)

# Initialize tmp2 with inverse factorials based on count
for i in range(max_power + 1):
    tmp2[count[i]][i] = inv_fact[i]

def perform_transform(arr, length, inverse=False):
    temp = [0] * length
    for i in range(length):
        temp[i] = arr[i]
    step = 1
    while step < length:
        for j in range(0, length, step * 2):
            for k in range(j, j + step):
                if inverse:
                    temp[k + step] -= temp[k]
                else:
                    temp[k + step] += temp[k]
        step <<= 1
    for i in range(length):
        arr[i] = temp[i] % p

def combine():
    for j in range(20):
        for s in range(max_power + 1):
            tmp1[j][s] = 0
            t[j][s] = 0
    for j in range(max_power + 1):
        tmp1[count[j]][j] = f[j]
    for j in range(20):
        perform_transform(tmp1[j], max_power + 1)
    for q in range(20):
        for l in range(20 - q):
            for s in range(max_power + 1):
                t[q + l][s] += tmp1[q][s] * tmp2[l][s]
                t[q + l][s] %= p
    for q in range(20):
        for s in range(max_power + 1):
            tmp3[q][s] = t[q][s] % p
    for j in range(20):
        perform_transform(tmp3[j], max_power + 1, inverse=True)
    for j in range(max_power + 1):
        f[j] = tmp3[count[j]][j]

def combine_alternate():
    for i in range(20):
        for s in range(max_power + 1):
            t[i][s] = 0
    for q in range(20):
        for l in range(20 - q):
            for s in range(max_power + 1):
                t[q + l][s] += tmp2[q][s] * tmp2[l][s]
                t[q + l][s] %= p
    for q in range(20):
        for s in range(max_power + 1):
            tmp[q][s] = t[q][s] % p
    for i in range(20):
        perform_transform(tmp[i], max_power + 1, inverse=True)
    for i in range(20):
        for s in range(max_power + 1):
            tmp2[i][s] = 0
    for i in range(max_power + 1):
        tmp2[count[i]][i] = tmp[count[i]][i]
    for i in range(20):
        perform_transform(tmp2[i], max_power + 1)

res_k = k
while res_k:
    if res_k & 1:
        combine()
    res_k >>= 1
    if res_k:
        combine_alternate()

result = (power_mod(k, n) - fact[n] * f[n] % p + p) % p
print(result)
